analysis: Common broadcast plus spatial dictionaries on exact reciprocal-cable shunt responses
budget_rule: K includes a constant column and K-1 spatial columns; retain only budgets with K <= number of E-bearing segments and K-1 <= number of I-bearing segments. Do not replace unavailable K=8 outcomes by a tuned budget.
pinky_qc: Retain the inherited qc_included flag, report excluded cells. Budget eligibility is additional and reported separately.
morphology_selection: Select K-1 existing ancestry columns by descending beta times E-weighted descendant fraction, preserving the existing np.argsort ordering; no response-dependent selection.
random_selection: K-1 inhibitory sites without replacement; common independent deterministic random stream per cell and budget.
shuffle_selection: Independently permute each selected ancestry column over sites; never shuffle the constant column.
surrogate_selection: Use the existing degree/depth matched parent-slot randomization, recompute ancestry and morphological leverage, then select K-1 columns. Hold original response, sites and beta fixed.
depth_selection: Use the inherited K depth bins. Add a constant and retain the first K-1 bins; this is the same span as all K bins, with its new wiring cost explicitly counted.
common_constrained_oracle: A constant plus the leading K-1 left singular vectors of the E-weighted response after projecting out that constant.
weights: E synapse sizes, scaled as in analyze_reciprocal_routing_controls.weighted_operator; use weighted orthogonal projectors throughout.
endpoints: Capture of weighted spatial residual after removing the common broadcast
Actual nonzero coefficients, density and coverage, separately from channel budget
inference: Average 200 randomized controls within each cell before paired cell summaries. Report paired mean differences, 95% cell-bootstrap intervals and Holm-adjusted two-sided Wilcoxon statistics across four spatial controls at K=8 per cohort. These quantify within-cohort consistency, not animal-population inference. Other K are descriptive.
scope: The original 8-cell augmentation is post hoc development.

The protocol is frozen before these independent-generator outcomes are computed in the 47 disjoint v661 cells or Pinky; both cohorts had previously been analyzed using route-generated positive controls.
v661 is the same MICrONS mouse as original8, not an independent animal.
Pinky is one separately documented animal; cells are nested within that animal.
Equal channel count is not equal wiring or necessarily equal actual rank.
Modeled response capacity is not measured endogenous use of dendritic learning signals.
Surrogate comparison distinguishes coarse ancestry statistics from specificity of individual branch identities.
